name: Virginia

flag.description: A dark blue field with the state seal on a white disc in the center: the figure of Virtue, armed with a spear and sword, standing over the fallen figure of Tyranny, with "Virginia" above and "Sic Semper Tyrannis" below, inside a ring of Virginia creeper.
flag.symbolism: Virtue defeating Tyranny, whose crown lies on the ground, celebrates the overthrow of British rule; the motto means "Thus always to tyrants".

hook: Virginia's seal sits on a bright white disc and shows a warrior woman with her foot on a fallen tyrant.
trivia: Virtue is shown with one breast bare, making Virginia's the only US state flag with nudity.
The design was first adopted in 1861 and given a precise legal specification in 1950.
